notes: CHK-001 folds the four sub-rules into a single assertion. The next-cycle rules (b), (c) and (d) are evaluated at edge N+1 using helper registers holding the previous-edge psel, penable and pready. A helper h_p_ok holds the previous-edge reset state, so the previous edge only counts if reset was released there. The antecedent is psel || penable || previous psel, which keeps the check active on the cycle after SETUP even if psel has dropped. I haven't compiled this or run it in Verilator.
